document_role: Master storyboard and asset binding data. Execution receipts and independent visual approval are separate evidence; this JSON is not a Remotion project.

text_asset_handoff.file_binding_policy: Read svg/png paths from text-content.json assets[] by id; do not infer missing files.
text_asset_handoff.required_behavior: Actual frame-driven whole-phrase mask/translation/opacity on independent text elements.
text_asset_handoff.grapheme_cluster_policy: Preserve Vietnamese grapheme clusters and diacritics; never split combining marks from base letters.
text_asset_handoff.reading_hold_policy: After landing, text remains sharp and stationary; only background or ribbon drifts.
text_asset_handoff.optional_agenda_extension: Additional topic and presenter assets in text-content.json belong in a separate agenda composition or a longer continuation, not all in the 20-second intro.
text_asset_handoff.source_grouping: Current text SVGs expose one whole-phrase *_RUN_01 per asset, not separate word or glyph outlines.
text_asset_handoff.word_animation_policy: Only if regenerated as native Unicode in a verified local font with shaping/diacritics checked. Do not pretend existing phrase outlines are per-word assets.
text_asset_handoff.window_convention: start inclusive, end exclusive; holds below have an inclusive last readable frame

independent_text_audit.verdict: APPROVE for text assets and generator only

frame_interval_convention: start inclusive, end exclusive; valid rendered frames 0 through 1199

brand.company_logo_policy: One complete supplied company logo in header/end-card; preserve artwork, aspect ratio, source colors, rule, trademark if present and tagline. No duplicate typed wordmark.
brand.wardrobe_policy: Preserve supplied clothing imagery; independent variable, never infer clothing text from header text.

asset_metadata_policy.dimensions_status: Measure actual files before composition; values are intentionally unknown here.
asset_metadata_policy.alpha_status: Expected transparency is a requirement to verify, not a proof of actual alpha.
asset_metadata_policy.scale_over_one_policy: Record as upscale and review 1:1 output crops. No claim of recovered native detail.
asset_metadata_policy.fallback: Use original whole-canvas hero with restrained 2D push and native text in verified free space if layers do not match. Avoid duplicate existing source logos/text.

motion_rules.clock: Pure function of useCurrentFrame and useVideoConfig; seconds converted using fps.
motion_rules.portrait_policy: Reflow layers and text independently; do not center-crop the entire landscape video.
motion_rules.audio_policy: Mute-first. Optional licensed audio only after actual source and rights verification.
motion_rules.assembly_grammar: arrive on axis -> align -> clamp with paired fixture -> lock -> activate cyan
motion_rules.inspiration_boundary: Suit-up mechanical rhythm only; no Iron Man character, armor, logo or footage.
motion_rules.text_render_policy: Use supplied phrase-outline SVG groups; native Unicode with verified font is an editable alternative. Do not bake the moving title into a static background.
motion_rules.fixture_update_status: Delivered M07-fixture.svg/png1000x800 reference pose. Timeline articulates two independent grippers with align/clamp/retract, physical latches and activation. Auxiliary fixture, not seventh MEP part.
